test: Check HTTPS certificate validity hostname and expiry
required_access: Authorized exact production hostname
tool_or_method: Bounded TLS handshake and certificate inspection
evidence_to_confirm: Certificate chain hostname validity and expiry metadata
fix_direction: Renew certificate and correct chain or hostname

test: Check HTTP redirects to HTTPS without downgrade loops
required_access: Authorized exact production hostname
tool_or_method: One request per scheme with redirect cap
evidence_to_confirm: Observed redirect chain and final scheme
fix_direction: Enforce HTTPS redirect and avoid downgrade targets

test: Check HSTS presence and safe directives on HTTPS response
required_access: Authorized exact production hostname
tool_or_method: Read response headers
evidence_to_confirm: Header value and response context; absence alone is a configuration observation
fix_direction: Set HSTS after confirming HTTPS coverage and subdomain readiness

test: Inspect Content-Security-Policy and report-only policy
required_access: Authorized exact production hostname
tool_or_method: Read response headers
evidence_to_confirm: Effective policy directives and endpoint; missing CSP alone is not proof of exploitable XSS
fix_direction: Define a tested restrictive policy and migrate from report-only

test: Check framing protection through CSP frame-ancestors or X-Frame-Options
required_access: Authorized exact production hostname
tool_or_method: Read response headers
evidence_to_confirm: Frame-control response headers
fix_direction: Set an explicit framing policy appropriate to embedding

test: Check MIME sniffing and referrer policy headers
required_access: Authorized exact production hostname
tool_or_method: Read response headers
evidence_to_confirm: nosniff and Referrer-Policy values
fix_direction: Set nosniff and a privacy-appropriate referrer policy

test: Check permissions policy limits sensitive browser features
required_access: Authorized exact production hostname
tool_or_method: Read response headers
evidence_to_confirm: Permissions-Policy value and enabled features
fix_direction: Restrict browser features to those required

test: Inspect cache directives on login account and sensitive responses
required_access: Authorized test account
tool_or_method: Read headers on approved account pages
evidence_to_confirm: Cache-Control directives on private responses
fix_direction: Prevent shared caching of sensitive authenticated content

test: Verify anonymous requests cannot read account-only routes or API resources
required_access: Two owned test accounts and anonymous context
tool_or_method: Compare normal page/API reads across three contexts
evidence_to_confirm: Anonymous receives no protected data and expected authorization status
fix_direction: Enforce authorization on server for every protected route

test: Verify logout invalidates the session and subsequent protected reads
required_access: Owned test account
tool_or_method: Login then logout then revisit one protected resource
evidence_to_confirm: Post-logout request is denied and sensitive cached content is not restored
fix_direction: Revoke server-side session or token and clear protected client state

test: Verify session/token expiry is enforced server-side
required_access: Owned test account and configured expiry knowledge
tool_or_method: Wait for documented test-token expiry then repeat read
evidence_to_confirm: Expired credential rejected by server
fix_direction: Apply bounded access-token lifetime and validate expiry centrally

test: Verify refresh-token rotation/reuse handling where supported
required_access: Owned test account and identity-provider test configuration
tool_or_method: Provider sandbox and controlled refresh sequence
evidence_to_confirm: Prior refresh credential reuse is rejected or safely handled
fix_direction: Rotate and revoke refresh credentials with provider-supported policy

test: Verify password reset token is single-use and expires
required_access: Owned test account and mail sandbox
tool_or_method: Mail sandbox flow using own account
evidence_to_confirm: Expired or consumed reset token cannot change credentials
fix_direction: Use random short-lived single-use reset tokens and invalidate sessions as policy requires

test: Verify account recovery does not disclose account existence through material response differences
required_access: Owned test account and non-existent test identifier
tool_or_method: Compare response semantics and timing in controlled test
evidence_to_confirm: Externally distinguishable enumeration signal is absent or intentionally risk-accepted
fix_direction: Normalize recovery responses and rate-limit abuse

test: Verify cookie Secure HttpOnly and SameSite attributes for session cookies
required_access: Authorized exact production hostname
tool_or_method: Inspect Set-Cookie headers
evidence_to_confirm: Session cookie flags and scope
fix_direction: Set appropriate Secure HttpOnly SameSite Path and Domain attributes
source: ASVS5; WSTG; OWASP Session Management Cheat Sheet

test: Verify state-changing browser requests have CSRF protection when cookie-authenticated
required_access: Owned test account
tool_or_method: Review request tokens/origin controls using benign test action
evidence_to_confirm: Untrusted cross-site context cannot trigger a protected state change
fix_direction: Use framework CSRF defense and validate origin as supplementary control
source: ASVS5; WSTG; OWASP CSRF Prevention Cheat Sheet

test: Verify login and recovery throttles avoid account lockout denial of service
required_access: Owned test account and staging rate-limit controls
tool_or_method: Small agreed request budget against test identity only
evidence_to_confirm: Bounded requests trigger safe throttling without affecting other users
fix_direction: Apply risk-based throttling with abuse-resistant recovery

test: Verify client-only route guards do not substitute for API authorization
required_access: Owned test account and API route map
tool_or_method: Compare direct API reads with UI visibility in two accounts
evidence_to_confirm: Server refuses data/action when client guard is bypassed
fix_direction: Enforce authorization at trusted server/data layer

test: Verify MFA enrollment and recovery actions require fresh appropriate authentication where supported
required_access: Owned test accounts and staging identity provider
tool_or_method: Provider sandbox flow review
evidence_to_confirm: Sensitive MFA changes require expected proof and audit trail
fix_direction: Require reauthentication and secure recovery for MFA changes

test: Verify session fixation protection across authentication transition
required_access: Owned test account
tool_or_method: Compare session identifier before and after login
evidence_to_confirm: Pre-authentication session cannot remain the authenticated credential
fix_direction: Rotate session identifier on privilege change

test: Verify changing a test-owned record identifier cannot read another test account record
required_access: Two owned test accounts with seeded records
tool_or_method: Substitute only identifiers belonging to the second owned test account
evidence_to_confirm: No cross-account record data returned
fix_direction: Authorize object ownership on every read
source: API Top 10 API1; ASVS5; Cloudflare ATTACK-CLASSES

test: Verify changing record identifier cannot update/delete another test account record
required_access: Two owned test accounts and disposable seeded records
tool_or_method: Attempt one reversible or disposable record action only
evidence_to_confirm: Unauthorized write is denied and record remains unchanged
fix_direction: Enforce object-level authorization on mutations and verify state

test: Verify tenant ID supplied by browser is not trusted as authorization
required_access: Two owned tenants and test identities
tool_or_method: Compare tenant context selected by server versus client request
evidence_to_confirm: Changing client tenant selector grants no additional access
fix_direction: Derive tenant scope from authenticated server-side principal

test: Verify Supabase Row Level Security is enabled and policy-scoped for exposed tables
required_access: Source/schema access and two test users; Supabase project read access optional
tool_or_method: Inspect migrations and policy definitions then run dummy-user integration cases
evidence_to_confirm: Unauthenticated and other-tenant reads/writes are denied for each exposed table
fix_direction: Enable RLS and write explicit least-privilege policies for select insert update delete
source: ASVS5; Supabase official RLS docs; Cloudflare DATA-ISOLATION-AND-LIFECYCLE

test: Verify Supabase service-role key is never shipped to browser or public build output
required_access: Build artifact/source access
tool_or_method: Gitleaks or focused source/build artifact inspection with secret-safe redaction
evidence_to_confirm: Service-role credential absent from browser bundles source maps and public config
fix_direction: Keep privileged keys server-side in secret manager and rotate if exposed
source: Supabase official API key docs; Cloudflare CLOUD-AND-DEPLOYMENT

test: Verify Supabase anonymous/publishable key access is constrained by RLS and grants
required_access: Source/schema access and dummy project users
tool_or_method: Review grants and RLS then execute dummy-principal integration tests
evidence_to_confirm: Public key accesses only explicitly permitted rows and actions; public key alone is not a privileged-secret finding
fix_direction: Restrict grants and enforce RLS for all client-exposed tables
source: Supabase official API key and RLS docs; ASVS5

test: Verify tenant isolation for uploaded files and signed download URLs
required_access: Two owned test accounts with disposable files
tool_or_method: Request each test account's own and other test account's file metadata/download
evidence_to_confirm: Other tenant cannot obtain bytes or valid access URL
fix_direction: Authorize storage object paths and issue short-lived scoped signed URLs

test: Verify vector-store/search results and citations are tenant-scoped
required_access: Two owned tenants and seeded synthetic documents
tool_or_method: Query with each test identity against synthetic data
evidence_to_confirm: Results chunks metadata and citations contain only caller-authorized tenant data
fix_direction: Apply tenant filters at retrieval boundary and isolate indexes/namespaces as required

test: Verify exports and background-job results preserve tenant ownership
required_access: Two owned tenants and synthetic records
tool_or_method: Create bounded export/job per account and inspect authorized result links
evidence_to_confirm: Job status output and export contents remain tenant-scoped
fix_direction: Bind job/export ownership server-side and authorize every retrieval

test: Verify object/property authorization prevents mass assignment of privileged fields
required_access: Owned test account and staging fixture
tool_or_method: Submit documented benign profile update with unexpected protected property
evidence_to_confirm: Protected role tenant billing or verification fields remain unchanged
fix_direction: Allowlist writable fields and enforce policy server-side

test: Verify pagination/search filters do not bypass tenant filters
required_access: Two owned tenants and synthetic records
tool_or_method: Compare normal and boundary pagination for two test principals
evidence_to_confirm: No cross-tenant rows or counts leak through list/search endpoints
fix_direction: Apply tenant predicate before pagination aggregation and counting

test: Verify caches use tenant/user-aware keys for personalized content
required_access: Two owned test accounts and staging observability
tool_or_method: Repeat identical safe reads under separate accounts
evidence_to_confirm: Responses do not reuse another principal's private content
fix_direction: Include authorization scope in cache keys or bypass shared caching

test: Check rendered user-controlled text is contextually encoded in common pages
required_access: Source or owned test content and staging
tool_or_method: Review templates and benign inert marker rendering
evidence_to_confirm: User text remains text in HTML/DOM contexts; no script execution attempted
fix_direction: Use context-aware output encoding and safe templating

test: Review SQL/ORM query construction for untrusted values entering query syntax
required_access: Source access and local dummy database
tool_or_method: Static source review and unit tests with inert typed values
evidence_to_confirm: All untrusted values are parameterized and query structure is fixed
fix_direction: Use parameterized queries and least-privilege DB roles

test: Review command/process invocation for user-controlled shell interpretation
required_access: Source access and local dummy fixtures
tool_or_method: Static review and mocked process boundary
evidence_to_confirm: Untrusted data cannot alter executable or argument structure
fix_direction: Use fixed executable and argument arrays; avoid shell interpolation

test: Verify server-side URL fetch feature blocks private and metadata destinations
required_access: Source access plus isolated local mock network
tool_or_method: Unit test URL policy with mocked resolver and redirect chain
evidence_to_confirm: Private/link-local/metadata destinations and disallowed redirects are rejected before connection
fix_direction: Resolve and validate every address/redirect and enforce egress policy
source: ASVS5; API Top 10 API7; Cloudflare ATTACK-CLASSES; OWASP SSRF Prevention Cheat Sheet

test: Verify URL fetch restricts schemes ports and redirects to approved scope
required_access: Source access and local isolated mock
tool_or_method: Test allowlist parser/resolver with dummy destinations
evidence_to_confirm: Unsupported schemes ports and out-of-scope redirects fail closed
fix_direction: Allowlist schemes/hosts/ports and revalidate each redirect
source: ASVS5; API Top 10 API7; OWASP SSRF Prevention Cheat Sheet

test: Verify file upload enforces size type and extension rules on server
required_access: Owned account and disposable staging upload area
tool_or_method: Upload harmless tiny fixtures of allowed and disallowed declared types
evidence_to_confirm: Server validates content policy and rejects disallowed files without serving them
fix_direction: Enforce size and type allowlists server-side and store outside executable web root
source: ASVS5; WSTG; OWASP File Upload Cheat Sheet

test: Verify uploaded files are isolated from other tenants and served with safe content disposition
required_access: Two owned test accounts and harmless fixtures
tool_or_method: Upload benign text fixtures and request through each account
evidence_to_confirm: Other account denied and active content is not rendered inline unexpectedly
fix_direction: Use tenant-bound storage and safe response content headers or isolated origin
source: ASVS5; WSTG; Cloudflare DATA-ISOLATION-AND-LIFECYCLE; OWASP File Upload Cheat Sheet

test: Verify rich text sanitization blocks active markup in controlled local fixture
required_access: Source access and isolated browser fixture
tool_or_method: Review sanitizer configuration and inert test corpus
evidence_to_confirm: Disallowed active markup is removed while allowed formatting remains
fix_direction: Use maintained context-appropriate sanitizer and safe rendering sink

test: Verify CORS allows only intended origins and credential behavior
required_access: Authorized exact production hostname and documented client origins
tool_or_method: Inspect CORS preflight/response for approved and unapproved Origin values using benign requests
evidence_to_confirm: Credentialed responses are not broadly shared with arbitrary origins
fix_direction: Use explicit origin allowlist and avoid wildcard credentials

test: Verify GraphQL resolver authorization and bounded query complexity where present
required_access: Source/schema and test accounts
tool_or_method: Schema review and small bounded authorized queries
evidence_to_confirm: Resolver data respects caller access and configured complexity limits
fix_direction: Authorize at resolver/field level and enforce query depth/cost limits

test: Verify error responses omit stack traces and internal secrets
required_access: Authorized exact production hostname and safe invalid input
tool_or_method: Inspect ordinary error response from a harmless invalid route or request
evidence_to_confirm: Response contains no stack trace tokens connection strings or private filesystem details
fix_direction: Return generic client errors and keep diagnostics in protected logs

test: Verify request size and content-type limits reject unexpected bodies safely
required_access: Staging endpoint and test account if required
tool_or_method: Bounded small request cases within agreed limits
evidence_to_confirm: Malformed or oversized requests are rejected without resource-intensive processing
fix_direction: Set request-size limits and strict content-type parsing

test: Check browser bundle and public build config for known secret patterns with redacted output
required_access: Source/build artifact access
tool_or_method: Gitleaks or equivalent scanner on supplied artifacts; report locations/types without values
evidence_to_confirm: Verified secret-like credential classification and file path only; HTTP 200 is not evidence of secret exposure
fix_direction: Remove privileged secret from client artifacts and rotate confirmed credentials
source: Gitleaks license-reviewed in research; ASVS5; Supabase API key docs

test: Check NEXT_PUBLIC and equivalent client-exposed environment variables for privileged credentials
required_access: Source and build artifact access
tool_or_method: Inspect public env references and generated bundle names with secret-safe output
evidence_to_confirm: Privileged credential used in public variable or bundle; public client identifiers are not automatically secrets
fix_direction: Move credentials to server-only configuration and rotate exposed secrets

test: Review source maps for embedded secrets or sensitive source disclosures
required_access: Build artifact access
tool_or_method: Inspect generated source maps using automated secret-safe scanner
evidence_to_confirm: Specific sensitive value/source confirmed; source map presence alone is not critical
fix_direction: Remove embedded secret and decide access policy for maps

test: Scan lockfiles/SBOM for known vulnerable dependencies and reachability context
required_access: Lockfiles or SBOM
tool_or_method: Trivy or equivalent pinned database-backed artifact scan
evidence_to_confirm: Package/version/advisory and whether app includes dependency; skipped feed checks are disclosed
fix_direction: Upgrade or mitigate affected reachable dependency and pin reviewed versions

test: Review dependency install scripts and package sources for unexpected supply-chain execution
required_access: Source/lockfile access
tool_or_method: Static manifest and lockfile review without installing packages
evidence_to_confirm: Unexpected source/script or unpinned dependency path identified
fix_direction: Pin trusted sources and constrain install/build execution

test: Verify security-sensitive secrets are not logged in app errors or telemetry
required_access: Source/log access with synthetic requests
tool_or_method: Review logging paths and synthetic token sentinel in isolated test
evidence_to_confirm: Sentinel absent from logs and error/analytics payloads
fix_direction: Redact secrets at logging boundary and restrict telemetry access
source: ASVS5; Cloudflare CLOUD-AND-DEPLOYMENT; OWASP Secrets Management Cheat Sheet

test: Check dependency freshness and end-of-life risk from supplied manifest
required_access: Lockfiles or SBOM
tool_or_method: Package metadata audit with pinned advisory data
evidence_to_confirm: Unsupported package versions clearly separated from confirmed exploitable vulnerabilities
fix_direction: Upgrade unsupported components and track exceptions

test: Review source and deployment config for exposed admin/debug endpoints
required_access: Source and build/deployment config
tool_or_method: Static route/config review and documented environment mapping
evidence_to_confirm: Reachable privileged debug route confirmed only with active deployment evidence
fix_direction: Disable or protect debug/admin routes in production

test: Review object storage bucket/container public access and effective policy
required_access: Provider configuration read access or rendered config
tool_or_method: Read-only policy/config review with owner-provided rendered settings
evidence_to_confirm: Effective anonymous access and affected object scope established; manifest alone is not live exposure
fix_direction: Block public access and grant least-privilege identities

test: Review app workload identity permissions against required resources
required_access: Provider IAM read access and deployment mapping
tool_or_method: Map workload identity to concrete permission set
evidence_to_confirm: Unneeded permission and reachable workload path documented
fix_direction: Reduce role to resource/action scope and separate duties

test: Verify production build excludes development-only auth bypasses and insecure defaults
required_access: Source and rendered production config
tool_or_method: Compare effective build/runtime configuration for production
evidence_to_confirm: Production config uses intended auth TLS tenant policy and debug settings
fix_direction: Make production configuration explicit and fail closed on missing controls

test: Review CI secrets exposure across pull request and deployment workflows
required_access: Workflow source and CI policy read access
tool_or_method: Trace which events/principals can access each secret and deployment permission
evidence_to_confirm: Untrusted contribution cannot obtain production secret or deployment authority
fix_direction: Use protected environments least privilege and trusted-event secret gates

test: Verify build artifacts are promoted from trusted immutable build to production
required_access: Workflow source and release metadata
tool_or_method: Trace build identity artifact digest approvals and deployment path
evidence_to_confirm: Unreviewed or mutable artifact cannot bypass release policy
fix_direction: Bind approval and deploy to immutable artifact digest

test: Review backups exports and deletion lifecycle for tenant scope and retention
required_access: Provider config and synthetic test data access
tool_or_method: Trace one synthetic record through backup/export/delete lifecycle
evidence_to_confirm: Copy access is scoped and deletion behavior/retention is documented and enforced
fix_direction: Apply tenant-aware ACLs retention limits and deletion propagation

test: Verify storage signed links expire and scope to intended object/action
required_access: Provider config and owned disposable object
tool_or_method: Issue own test object's link and verify documented expiry in controlled window
evidence_to_confirm: Expired or altered scope does not authorize access
fix_direction: Use short-lived narrowly scoped signed URLs

test: Review deployment ingress and network policy for unintended public management surfaces
required_access: Rendered deployment config and provider read access
tool_or_method: Map external listeners and attached policies
evidence_to_confirm: Unintended management endpoint exposure confirmed from effective deployment state
fix_direction: Restrict ingress and bind management surfaces to trusted networks

test: Verify scan/job workers receive only required secrets and cannot access peer tenant artifacts
required_access: Source/deployment config and dummy worker integration
tool_or_method: Inspect environment mounts and test isolated worker fixture
evidence_to_confirm: Worker secret/artifact access is limited to assigned job and tenant
fix_direction: Use per-job identity and isolated temporary storage

test: Verify payment webhook signature is checked over raw request body using provider test event
required_access: Payment provider sandbox and test endpoint
tool_or_method: Provider sandbox test webhook with official test signature
evidence_to_confirm: Unsigned or invalid-signature event does not alter payment state
fix_direction: Verify provider signature using documented raw-body procedure
source: Provider official webhook docs; ASVS5; Stripe webhook signature docs as provider example; use configured provider docs

test: Verify webhook replay/idempotency prevents duplicate fulfillment
required_access: Provider sandbox and disposable test order
tool_or_method: Replay same provider test event through documented sandbox tooling
evidence_to_confirm: Repeated event does not duplicate entitlement shipment or credit
fix_direction: Persist provider event IDs and make effects idempotent
source: Provider official webhook docs; API Top 10 API6; Stripe webhook signature docs as provider example; use configured provider docs

test: Verify webhook event is bound to expected merchant account and environment
required_access: Provider sandbox read access
tool_or_method: Use provider-supplied sandbox event/account metadata
evidence_to_confirm: Foreign account or test/live mode mismatch cannot update local state
fix_direction: Validate account identity mode and expected object association

test: Verify price amount currency and product identity are derived from trusted server/provider data
required_access: Test account and payment sandbox
tool_or_method: Compare server-created test checkout with completed sandbox event
evidence_to_confirm: Client-modified display fields cannot set charged amount or entitlement
fix_direction: Resolve price/product from server-side catalog and provider-confirmed event

test: Verify entitlement/credit changes require verified payment state transition
required_access: Provider sandbox and disposable account
tool_or_method: Exercise documented test lifecycle and inspect entitlement transition
evidence_to_confirm: Only verified provider state grants entitlement and duplicate transitions are safe
fix_direction: Centralize state machine validation and idempotent transitions

test: Verify coupon/refund/quantity limits cannot be bypassed through repeated normal requests
required_access: Disposable test account and staging business data
tool_or_method: Bounded sequence within agreed test-account limits
evidence_to_confirm: Server enforces business invariants despite repeated or reordered requests
fix_direction: Enforce atomic limits and idempotent state transitions server-side

test: Verify payment status pages do not treat browser redirect parameters as proof of payment
required_access: Test account and provider sandbox
tool_or_method: Review return flow with synthetic unverified status values
evidence_to_confirm: Entitlement remains unchanged until backend verifies provider state
fix_direction: Use provider webhook/API confirmation as authority

test: Verify audit trail records actor and state transition without payment secrets
required_access: Provider sandbox and source/log access
tool_or_method: Inspect synthetic event processing logs
evidence_to_confirm: Useful event identity recorded while signatures/tokens/payment secrets are redacted
fix_direction: Log safe identifiers and redact credential/payment data

test: Verify prompt-injected user content cannot override system policy or expose another tenant's synthetic data
required_access: AI feature staging and synthetic multi-tenant corpus
tool_or_method: Use inert approved test corpus and observe tool/data boundaries
evidence_to_confirm: Model output/tool policy preserves caller authorization; output alone is not proof of a vulnerability
fix_direction: Enforce access policy outside model prompts and isolate retrieval by tenant

test: Verify tool calls are authorized by deterministic server policy for the current user
required_access: AI staging app and test identities
tool_or_method: Inspect tool allowlist and test denied synthetic operation
evidence_to_confirm: Unauthorized tool operation is denied by server regardless of model request
fix_direction: Authorize tool/action at trusted backend using principal and resource

test: Verify MCP server tools expose only intended methods and resources to each principal
required_access: MCP staging server and two test principals
tool_or_method: Enumerate advertised capabilities and compare allowed roles
evidence_to_confirm: Unintended tool/resource access denied and data remains scoped
fix_direction: Apply per-tool/resource authorization and least-privilege scopes

test: Verify tool output is treated as untrusted data and cannot inject instructions into downstream agents
required_access: Source access and local mock tools
tool_or_method: Trace tool-result handling and run inert mocked output case
evidence_to_confirm: Tool output is delimited/validated and cannot alter privileged policy path
fix_direction: Keep policy outside model context and validate structured tool outputs

test: Verify retrieved documents citations and conversation history remain tenant-scoped
required_access: AI staging and synthetic per-tenant data
tool_or_method: Query each test identity using synthetic corpora and inspect citations/history
evidence_to_confirm: No other tenant's source text metadata or conversation state appears
fix_direction: Enforce tenant scope in retrieval storage history and citation resolution

test: Verify agent cannot fetch arbitrary URLs or internal services through tools
required_access: AI staging with URL-fetch tool and local mock policy
tool_or_method: Unit test deterministic URL policy and mocked redirects
evidence_to_confirm: Disallowed destination is rejected before network connection
fix_direction: Use same SSRF-safe egress policy for agent tools

test: Verify model provider/API credentials are server-side and excluded from browser and prompts/logs
required_access: Source/build artifact and synthetic telemetry access
tool_or_method: Secret-safe bundle scan and source/config path review
evidence_to_confirm: Credential absent from client artifacts model-visible user content and logs
fix_direction: Keep keys server-side redact telemetry and rotate confirmed exposure
source: ASVS5; Cloudflare AI-AND-LLM; Next.js official env docs

test: Verify agent approval gates for consequential actions cannot be skipped by prompt or tool ordering
required_access: AI staging with disposable test resource
tool_or_method: Exercise denied and approved dummy-action paths
evidence_to_confirm: Unapproved action has no side effect and approval is bound to exact action/resource
fix_direction: Enforce server-side approval state and bind confirmation to operation
